verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a public API and an official bot framework for writing and running custom bots, deployable via the first-party Zulip Botserver, which suggests official developer tooling to build against. However, the evidence never names an official SDK or client library, its supported languages, or its installation and reference docs. missing for 10: explicit evidence of official SDK/client libraries, language coverage, SDK reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
